domain: disclosure-process quality on the death-inclusive cohort: conditioning variables built from the amendment intensity and vintage inter-arrival cadence of the filer's latest filed period (V10-R3-AMEND-COUNT / V10-R4-INTER-ARRIVAL), with the EODHD price leg used only for eligibility, band assignment, fills and benchmark context; no revision DIRECTION or value-change content enters any arm (that is H1's mechanism), no price- or volume-derived observable is ranked, no T-clock observable is cited
title: Amendment-process quality: mean vintages-per-fact of the latest filed period as a slow low-quality discount, long clean single-vintage filers / short amendment-heavy filers

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_react_or_slow_to_react: Nobody is forced to react - that is the point. Amendment cadence is a process fact with no headline: multi-vintage filings are administrative corrections arriving inside amended documents, read by almost no one in real time. The slow side is the market's aggregate pricing of process quality; the mechanism predicts a slow, characteristic-level discount that accrues to the short leg over quarters, not an event-day move. This is the deliberately opposite falsification geometry to H1: H1 claims a fresh-news drift that a stale control must NOT reproduce; H2 claims a persistent characteristic that survives staleness and must instead be discriminated from sector composition.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: Firms whose filing process requires many corrected vintages have weak internal control over financial reporting and higher ex-ante probability of future restatement and miss (Dechow-Ge-Larson-Sloan 2011 lineage; internal-weakness and disclosure-quality literature). Quality pricing: opaque, unstable, low-quality firms are systematically overpriced relative to clean ones and underperform out of sample (Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019, Quality Minus Junk; Loughran-McDonald 2011: disclosure-quality measures priced in the cross-section; Skinner 1994: weak disclosers bear larger information-risk penalties). The premium is slow because the signal is low-salience and characteristic-persistent: it is harvested as a cross-sectional discount, not an announcement return. The multi-vintage panel makes this observable PIT-native on the death-inclusive cohort for the first time, including dying names where process breakdown is most extreme and least arbitraged.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: Per filer i at decision t, let P*(i,t) be the filer's latest filing period whose first vintage stamp is strictly before the decision-session start (timing is a filing property; PIT). A_i(t) = mean number of vintage stamps per field-group fact of period P* available by t (= 1 for a clean single-vintage period; > 1 by the amendment count carried in V10-R3). A_i is a pure process-instability intensity: its VALUE DIRECTION (up/down corrections) is deliberately unused - only the count/cadence of vintages. Cross-sectionally: long the cleanest tercile, short the amendment-heaviest tercile. The neighbour reads the adjacent knob V10-R4 (inter_arrival_days): the speed of the amendment stream. The control replaces each name's own intensity with its sector-period PIT-median, deleting all firm-specific content.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (a) if amendment propensity is generic small/distressed junk already fully priced, incremental alpha is nonpositive; (b) if the cross-sectional signal is sector-period composition (whole sectors amend in waves - tax, revenue-recognition, COVID-era periods) rather than firm-level process quality, the composition control reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x same-sign alpha) and the family dies, and by construction that failure is adjacent to veto entry #9 (sector-exposure form), which the D2 rho screen also polices; (c) if amendment intensity proxies any forbidden shadow (bloat/junk/accrual ancestry), the pooled |rho| > 0.20 screen kills it at D2; (d) if the characteristic is real but smaller than band-B/C costs on amendment-heavy names, expectancy is nonpositive; (e) if period-age incomparability (young periods have had no time to amend) dominates the cross-section, the anchor attenuates to noise.

falsifiable_prediction: The amendment-intensity tercile book (long clean / short heavy, gross 1.0, ~27 decisions per fold, 3 folds) has positive expectancy AFTER base band costs, position PF >= 1.1, >= 2 of 3 folds positive expectancy, max fold MDD <= 15%, risk-matched incremental alpha > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds, ETF-share <= 0.35, and |composition-control alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor alpha|. The family is FALSIFIED if any of: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; the composition control matches or outruns the anchor including the negative-anchor case (frozen falsification-by-control rule); pooled novelty rho > 0.20 vs any of the nine veto entries at D2; drop-one survival fails; the 2x stress rerun is nonpositive; reproduction is not ALL_MATCH.

universe.legs: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550); the full death-inclusive cohort of p3_v10_invariants_freeze.json. GAP_COVERAGE (513) and NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL (219) excluded, recorded, never held.
universe.eligibility: at each decision session a name is eligible iff: (i) >= 63 bars through the decision session; (ii) band C or better (ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD); (iii) RAW close >= 1.00 USD; (iv) >= 10 available field-groups of period P* (frozen denominator floor) and a computable score.
universe.dead_name_semantics: preregistered identically to H1: exit at last recorded close on the final session (delisting leg carried by the price series); fill-check enforced; no post-series prices; no survivorship re-substitution; alive/dead split used only as post-hoc attribution reporting.
universe.sector_fields: the frozen sector panel field is used in TWO sanctioned places only: the composition control's PIT medians, and the sector-ETF benchmark factor; it never conditions the anchor or neighbour.

clock.staleness: every conditioning input carries max_age_days 800 (P2 rule); period P* is the filer's LATEST first-stamped period, so its groups are recent by construction; no unbounded variant exists.
clock.no_contemporaneous_inputs: a group enters the score iff its stamps are strictly earlier than the decision session's start-of-day UTC (conservative-later bound for date-only stamps); the availability-lag mutation rule applies unchanged (a late vintage shifts amend_count/inter-arrival windows exactly one event, changing no direction content - there is none).
clock.T_clock_and_R1_R2_separation: no V10-T1/T2/T3 and no V10-R1/R2 observable is cited or conditioned in any arm; H2's information is the COUNT/CADENCE of vintages, structurally blind to revision direction and magnitude (the flat-vintage majority - 1,519,910 of 1,667,422 depth>=2 groups per the published P2 note - still funds these clocks, which is exactly why this mechanism is independent of H1's).

decision_grid: inherited 21-session grid: per-fold local session indices 63 + 21k, strictly inside each fold, on the union session calendar (~27 decisions per fold expected; exact counts computed by A9 from the frozen calendar). Folds frozen per p3: S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09, S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24. Force-flat at fold boundaries with cost. First grid decision per fold may abstain fail-closed where the control's PIT sector medians have < 30 prior-only peers (min_hist_cohort=30, frozen).
entry_exit_fills: identical to H1: PIT stamps strictly before decision-session start; eligibility/bands from bars through t-1; fills next session, close-to-close, no same-session fill; fill-check (missing bar = order does not exist, no leg renormalization, realized gross reported); 21-session holding; dead-name exit at last recorded close with C-rate ceiling for unrateable exits.

costs.model: band model per research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py, cited verbatim: BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of(ADV63): >= 50,000,000 A, >= 10,000,000 B, >= 2,000,000 C, else UNTRADABLE; entries never use the UNTRADABLE path.
costs.application: linear in fills (|dw| x band bps x multiplier / 10,000), charged exactly once per fill per side, on BOOKED PnL; no sidecar, no per-stamp accrual (V13 lesson).
costs.resolution: L-I3 fail-closed: missing band for a traded name raises BandResolutionError; silent 10 bps fallback forbidden; unrateable exits charge the C-rate ceiling (resolve_exit_band_bps) - computed, never defaulted.
costs.stress: stress tier = x2 on booked PnL (20/30/50 bps); gate: stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.0.

arms.spec: At each decision t: for every eligible name i with n_i >= 10 available period-P* groups, A_i(t) = (sum of vintage stamps over those groups) / n_i (mean vintages-per-fact; single-vintage groups count 1, multi-vintage groups carry their R3 amend_count + 1). Rank all scoreable names by A descending; LONG the bottom tercile (clean filers), SHORT the top tercile (amendment-heavy); equal weight within legs, 0.5 gross per leg; abstain if either leg < 5 names or the scoreable cohort < 30 names (frozen floors). Declared attenuation bias: names whose period P* is young (filed recently, little time to amend) read artificially clean, which DILUTES the anchor toward null - a conservative failure direction, accepted ex ante rather than patched with an age conditioner (that would be a second, unfrozen parameter).

Inter-arrival cadence book: I_i(t) = mean inter_arrival_days over i's period-P* multi-vintage groups with last stamp <= t (V10-R4; requires >= 1 such group else the name is unscored; all other machinery identical). Rank DESCENDING I: LONG slow-cadence (long intervals between vintages = stable process), SHORT fast-cadence. Tests whether the cadence (speed) of amendments carries the same quality content as the count. Expected to support the anchor (same sign, different knob); a sign flip marks the construct as knob-fragile and downweights the family (neighbour_mechanism_support gate inherited).

Composition-only control: C_i(t) = the PIT sector-period-type median of A_j over same-sector same-period-type peers j whose own A_j is computable entirely from stamps strictly before the calendar-month bucket start of t (month-bucket PIT rule mirroring the P0 cohort_norm convention; same-month peers excluded fail-closed; < 30 peers => C_i null => name unscored). Rank C, identical tercile book machinery. It deletes ALL firm-specific amendment content and retains only sector-period process composition. RUNNABLE under evidenced semantics by construction (all inputs are prior stamps; abstains wherever the anchor abstains; cannot abort on data semantics - the forex V3 lesson). If the control reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x same-sign alpha), the priced object is sector-period composition - adjacent to veto entry #9 (sector-exposure form) - and the family is FALSIFIED per the frozen rule. This is the V4 stale-rank precedent turned into the design's own gunsight: the control targets the exact confound most likely to be the truth.

exposure_definition: Per entity i at decision t, for the D2 rank-correlation screen against each of the nine veto entries on the same decision x entity cohort: EXPOSURE_i(t) = A_i(t) = (sum over field-groups g of filer i in its latest-first-stamped period P*(i,t), with first vintage stamp strictly before decision-session start, of v_g) / n_i, where v_g = number of vintage stamps of g at or before t (1 + its R3 amend_count for multi-vintage groups; 1 for single-vintage groups), n_i = count of such groups (>= 10 required, else unscored). Normalization: none beyond the mean-per-fact construction (a dimensionless count ratio); cross-sectional terciles by COUNT within the scored cohort at each decision. Ranking direction: DESCENDING A (most amendment-heavy = rank 1 = short leg). Inputs are exactly the two cited clock observables, the panel's group/period/stamp structure, and (control only) the frozen sector field; no price, volume, share-count or fundamentals ratio enters the exposure. D2 computes pooled Spearman rho of this exposure vs each veto entry exposure; pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required.

frozen_thresholds.group_denominator_floor_10: a proportion-like mean over fewer facts is a 1-of-2 artifact; 10 keeps the estimate meaningful while excluding almost no filer; frozen ex ante, not fitted.
frozen_thresholds.tercile_legs_with_floor_5: the standard rank-book convention of the program's stocks cells; legs below 5 names abstain (inherited accounting minimum).
frozen_thresholds.cohort_floor_30_scoreable: mirrors the layer's frozen min_hist_cohort=30 convention.
frozen_thresholds.control_peer_floor_30_and_month_bucket_p: inherited verbatim from the P0 cohort_norm rule (min_hist_cohort 30, same-month exclusion fail-closed) - no new control machinery invented.
frozen_thresholds.gross_1.0_half_per_leg: cross-sectional mechanism expressed market-neutral; the beta-dressing veto is designed out, and the alpha gates remain the crucible.

no_parameter_grid_declaration: one period rule, one intensity definition, one cadence neighbour, one control, one floor per concept - all frozen above with stated rationale; no grid over windows, terciles, floors, universes or costs; period-age is declared as an accepted attenuation bias, deliberately NOT patched.
incremental_alpha_test: per the frozen factor_and_benchmark contract: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context, per fold and overall; gate: overall alpha > 0 and >= 2 folds positive; secondary sector-ETF factor per fold; ETF-share <= 0.35. The neutral two-leg book makes beta dressing unlikely; the gates' expected bind is mechanism absence or composition confounding.
drop_one_design: (1) drop-one-symbol (max-contribution) rerun, survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0; (2) drop-one-fold, survival iff min over folds > 0; (3) anchor-extreme rerun excluding the 5 largest single-decision weights. Identical semantics in all reruns.

margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0: coin-flip ex ante; quality premia are slow and small; must clear an expected band-B/C-weighted ~15-25 bps/side; failure expected as a small negative.
margin_to_fail_expectations.position_pf_ge_1.1: expected thin if real (P-2); margin < 0.1 anticipated.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_of_3: MEDIUM-HIGH RISK: amendment waves cluster in periods (restatement cycles), so a single fold may carry the effect.
margin_to_fail_expectations.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: MEDIUM RISK for a neutral book; a sector-wide amendment episode can tilt the book within a fold.
margin_to_fail_expectations.incremental_alpha: the primary crucible together with the control; expected to pass only if firm-level process quality is priced incrementally.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt_0.5: MEDIUM-HIGH RISK and pre-committed: composition confounding is the most plausible truth of this signal; accept falsification without argument (V4 precedent).
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_2x: HIGH RISK if the base margin is thin (P-2).
margin_to_fail_expectations.scored_decision_floors: LOW-MEDIUM RISK: the flat-vintage majority funds these clocks densely (per the published P2 note), so books are expected populated every decision; the 10-group/30-cohort/5-leg floors make any sparsity fail safe.
margin_to_fail_expectations.novelty_rho_le_0.20: expected PASS vs all nine entries (a filing-process count shares no rank with momentum, variance, volume, balance-sheet, accrual, depletion, cash or sector-form exposures); measured at D2, never argued; declared risk: if amendment intensity empirically proxies generic junk, rho may approach the bloat/cash shadows - the gate decides.

failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_and_control_negative: amendment-process quality carries no tradable discount at these costs; REJECT with margin-to-fail per gate (P-2).
failure_interpretation.anchor_reproduced_by_control: the signal is sector-period composition, not firm-level disclosure quality; FALSIFIED (cluster instance), recorded, never rescued.
failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_control_positive: composition short is the earning object; the firm-level mechanism is absent or inverted; REJECT, informative shadow recorded.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_alpha_negative: generic junk factor dressed as process quality; REJECT.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_all_gates: Stage-A with preregistered parameters only; no re-tuning; margin-to-fail per gate.

novelty_declaration.vs_nine_entry_veto_set: the exposure is a count ratio over filing vintages - no return, variance, volume, balance-sheet composition, accrual flow, depletion, cash or sector-form quantity anywhere; measured |rho| <= 0.20 at D2 is expected to bind trivially and is pre-committed.
novelty_declaration.vs_prior_stocks_families: no prior family (V2-V9) conditioned on amendment cadence or any filing-process observable; the process-quality discount is a new information set on the new cohort.
novelty_declaration.vs_SFV10_A6_H1_same_cycle: mechanistically distinct: H1 trades the DIRECTION of value changes as fresh news under an underreaction claim (event-drift, R1/R2, stale-control falsifier); H2 trades the COUNT/CADENCE of vintages as a persistent quality characteristic (R3/R4, composition-control falsifier, direction-blind by construction - the 1,519,910 flat-vintage groups that carry no H1 signal are H2's home turf). The two falsifiers are mirror images: H1's control must NOT reproduce; H2's characteristic claim survives staleness and is instead killed by composition.
novelty_declaration.vs_axis_1_lane: no T-clock observable cited; filing lag plays no role.
novelty_declaration.vs_axis_2_lane_disclosure: no revision direction/magnitude conditioning (R1/R2 unused); declared for A1's within-cycle separation measurement at selection.
novelty_declaration.generic_mechanisms: quality-minus-junk and disclosure-quality lineages are cited as literature ancestors, not reused exposure forms: no profitability, growth, payout or textual-quality field enters any arm.
novelty_declaration.blocked_channels: PASS: staged sha-pinned SEC observables + owner-entitled EODHD prices only; no new vendor leg, no keyed fetch.
novelty_declaration.rescue_variant_check: no parameter, universe, sign or name variant of any forbidden family or rejected cell; the short-the-amendment-heavy leg is not a sign-flip of any recorded shadow.

infeasibility_declarations: dropped at design time: (1) deadline-distance conditioning - DATA_BLOCKED_VALID (p2 not_funded); (2) disclosure-volume (facts-count shock) - not a funded V10 clock; (3) revision-direction interaction with amendment count - would import H1's mechanism and collapse lane distinctiveness, dropped; (4) conditioning on WITHIN-period amendment arrival timing relative to the next scheduled filing - requires deadline evidence that does not exist (P-1), dropped.

source_to_test_map.inputs: .staging_sec_v10/v10_revision_observables.jsonl (amend_count, inter_arrival_days, last_avail; sha-pinned in p0_v10_observable_manifest.json) + the panel's group/period/stamp structure (sha-pinned multivintage panel) + staged EODHD series (owner-entitled) + p2_v10_coverage_first.json (funded clocks incl. the flat-vintage funding note) + p3_v10_invariants_freeze.json (folds, cohort, costs, min_hist) + the frozen sector field for the control and benchmark only.
source_to_test_map.pipeline: load R3/R4 rows with stamps -> per-decision period-P* intensity -> tercile books -> eligibility/bands from bars through t-1 -> next-session fills with fill-check -> band-aware costs (L-I3 fail-closed) -> folds -> Stage-A gates + composition control + drop-one + stress rerun + alive/dead stratified attribution.
source_to_test_map.not_touched: no T-clock observable, no R1/R2 direction/magnitude, no deadline evidence, no fundamentals ratio, no price-derived signal.

implementation_estimate: single serial cell: revision JSONL scan + period aggregation (minutes), price load, ~80-decision grid, three arms + stress + drop-one; well under the 120-minute per-cell timeout and 8 GB; heavy_cap 1; no network fetch.
literature: Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen (2019), 'Quality Minus Junk', Review of Accounting Studies 24 - low-quality firms underperform; the characteristic-level pricing claim
Dechow, Ge, Larson & Sloan (2011), 'Predicting Material Accounting Misstatements', Contemporary Accounting Research 28(1) - process/restatement-precursor signals as ex-ante quality measures

Loughran & McDonald (2011), 'When Is a Liability Not a Liability? Textual Analysis, Discourse Complexity, and Small-Cap Stocks' (and their 10-K quality line), Journal of Finance 66(1) - disclosure-quality measures priced in the cross-section
Skinner (1994), 'Why Do Firms Voluntarily Disclose Bad News?', Journal of Accounting Research 32(1) - information-risk penalty for weak disclosers
Francis, Nanda & Olsson (2008), 'Voluntary Disclosure and Earnings Quality', The Accounting Review 83(6) - disclosure quality and cost of capital
Bernard & Thomas (1989, 1990) - cited as the shared slow-diffusion backdrop that H2 must NOT be: H2's claim is characteristic persistence, which is why its falsifier is composition, not staleness
outcome_blind_attestation: No returns, PnL, per-arm outcome or any scored metric exists in this packet or was computed for it; no outcome file was read (none exists); every count cited is a published Phase-P census number from the frozen control artifacts (p0/p2/p3, run_contract); the exposure uses only sanctioned clock observables and their own availability stamps. The proposal is frozen at wave SHA bc4b028d8b5d552cff9f56d417a8f17265534645 and remains falsifiable in every preregistered direction.
